description: Prior approval for the change of use from Class E (commercial) to Class C3 (dwellinghouses) to provide ten 1 bed residential units
decision_conditions: <p>﻿﻿<span id="docs-internal-guid-1e49ace7-7fff-690c-f986-5154687b3098" style=""><span style="font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposal would not satisfy the requirements of paragraph MA.1.(1)(b), of Class MA, Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).&nbsp; Sufficient evidence is available to confirm the use of the subject building as a music recording studio and live music venue, and is therefore considered to fall with a Sui Generis Use. Therefore, the use of the subject building</span></span> does not fall within one or more of the classes specified in sub-paragraph (2) for a continuous period of at least 2 years prior to the date of the application for prior approval. </p>

<p>In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permits, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety,&nbsp; sustainable modes of transport and would contribute to congestion in the surrounding area contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45. Having regard to The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Part MA.2(2)(a), the change of use is not supported on the basis of adverse impact on on-street parking conditions and highway safety.</p>

<p>﻿﻿<span id="docs-internal-guid-1e49ace7-7fff-690c-f986-5154687b3098"><span style="font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposal would not satisfy the requirements of paragraph MA.2.(2)(f) of Class MA, Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended). The proposed development, by reason of poor levels of daylight, would provide a sub-standard form of accommodation to the detriment of future occupiers, contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>
